findings.decision: CPU-Slurm-only preparation requires a fresh derived source configuration. CodeAlpaca bytes must match pinned size and Git blob before a derived SHA256 is written; corpus preparation then verifies all source sizes and SHA256 hashes.

Alpaca original answers and nonempty instruction/context text are preserved; instruction and context are joined by two newlines. Canonical rows retain domain, source row/revision and available upstream source labels.
Prior chat exclusions rehash the pinned completion and all three canonical split files before excluding exact normalized individual user turns.

Deterministic seeded selection operates on complete single-turn connected groups after exclusions and prompt deduplication. Cross-source retained families fail closed. Group splitting precedes teacher generation.

approved_use: Prepare the exact configured bounded math/code input population and produce target-only teacher responses using the existing separately frozen generation pipeline. Preserve original-response files and source provenance.
checks: Read all new pilot adapter/config and full corpus implementation, diff, tests and teacher input/output propagation.

Independently ran PYTHONPATH=src python3 -B -Werror -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_corpus.py -v on the final tests hash: eleven tests passed, including end-to-end prior-chat/reference exclusion and bounded selection plus Git-blob mismatch rejection before config publication.
Parsed reviewed Python sources and verified unchanged approved native_training/admission_v2 hashes. No network or cluster access.
execution_evidence_still_required: Freeze a separate hash-bound source/config bundle without changing active run bundles or their source paths.
Retain downloaded upstream sizes and pinned SHA256/Git-blob checks, derived configuration hash, preparation adapter identity and raw source provenance.
Retain per-source schema/exclusion/dedup/selection counts, realized group/row counts and split membership; independently validate prompt/group disjointness and the claimed exact-overlap exclusions.
Retain teacher plan/input hashes, actual eight-GPU hardware/runtime/settings receipts, every selected ordinal outcome and rejection reason, EOS-completion evidence and final corpus hashes.
Apply unchanged native tokenization/length QA to generated corpora before any later training admission. Input group limits are not post-filter dataset-size conditions.
Review the actual new teacher launch/dependency attachment separately; this source receipt does not attest to a submitted job, scheduling safety or successful generation.
limitations: The configured cap is twenty thousand connected groups per source, not a universal twenty-thousand-row cap; whole families may contain multiple records.

Exclusion is exact NFKC/casefold/whitespace-normalized individual user-turn overlap against the pinned reference-panel and chat-corpus records. It is not semantic, paraphrase, code-clone or full-benchmark decontamination.
The review verifies enforcement of configured immutable identities. It does not independently authenticate upstream ownership, license declarations or dataset content through network inspection.

Selection is defined before target generation and length filtering. No response-quality selection, matched-budget training comparison, completed ten-thousand post-filter condition or trained-quality result is approved.

Original and target-generated responses must retain paired input/split identities for later comparisons; differing teacher or length-filter survival must be reported rather than silently treated as matched populations.

Download/preparation failures can leave partial local artifacts or a derived config without a completion receipt. Such artifacts are not completed inputs; retry using verified raw bytes and fresh derived/output paths.
